content.text:
Keep strictness in `searchConfiguration` as an internal API policy. Remove it from `PageModel`, `searchEntities`’s arguments, `SearchPage` state and UI, and URL link helpers. `searchEntities` should still send the configured value to the Rust API.

Treat legacy `strictness` URL parameters as ignored. Retain only `q` in search and detail links; no redirect is needed. Update browser checks to confirm the slider is gone, API requests use the configured default, and legacy URLs behave like URLs without strictness. The existing shared application configuration is the smallest fit; server environment configuration would make sense only if operators need per-environment tuning.
